subject: Opal as an independent self-hosted server (headless build), not as a client of Jellyfin/Plex

statuses.verified: A cited test executes the shipped server behaviour against owned fixtures and passes.
statuses.fixture-only: Only pure helpers, extracted SQL or source inspection exercise it; no end-to-end server test.
statuses.unverified: No test exercises it, or the feature does not exist.

suites.ci: Deterministic, owned fixtures, run by .github/workflows on every push.
suites.opt-in: Deterministic live headless test with owned fixtures; run by hand, not in CI.
suites.real-provider: Needs real libraries, providers or hardware; never part of CI.

environments.nas_class: Small NAS-class host (low-core ARM/x86, spinning disk).

evidence.test: tests/features/test_library.py::Local library is indexed, correctable, and duplicate-aware

workstation.note: Add-root, scan and rescan after deletion; the end-to-end test is not in CI.

nas_class.note: No large-library or slow-disk scan measured.

workstation.note: Title/kind correction of the local index survives a rescan. No catalog re-match route exists.
Admin creates a second account that logs in with its own session.

evidence.test: src/services/access_pure.zig::route privilege matrix protects host administration and executable trust

workstation.note: Regular sessions get 403 on host administration; login lockout is shared across username case.
No DB/config/profile backup feature exists; only a one-level cleared-history undo.

evidence.test: tests/features/test_database.py::Exact resume: schema v4 + path and catalog identity
src/services/tv_merge.zig::merge: a failing pair rolls back whole

workstation.note: Shipped schema SQL runs on a synthetic legacy DB in sqlite; the binary never upgrades a real old profile in a test, and the zigzag-to-opal path migration is untested.

evidence.test: src/services/stream_pure.zig::stopped streaming slot cannot be reused until creation and requests release it
src/services/stream_pure.zig::stream helpers: ffprobe sibling, percent, idle

workstation.note: Slot and idle helpers only. No test hits the two-session cap, the idle reap or the /transcode watchdog.

nas_class.note: Encoder throughput on low-core hosts not measured.

workstation.note: Concurrent API connections are tested; several simultaneous media streams are not.
